description: This file defines the SubmissionService class, which manages data product submissions, including creation, retrieval, state updates, and test setup functions. It interacts with database tables for submissions, drafts, and pipeline jobs, and uses external services for auditing and draft management.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service for submission lifecycle and state machine management.

methods.name: ensure_minimal_submission_for_tests
methods.description: Sets up minimal submission data for testing purposes, creating drafts and submissions in 'in_review' state for specific test IDs.

methods.name: create_submission
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft, queues a validation job, and records audit events.

methods.name: get_submission
methods.description: Retrieves a submission by its ID.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a submission and logs the change via audit events.
